name: Georgia
credit: Data: What's In My County, published by Priori Intelligence

ww_covid_n_sites.label: COVID-19 sampling sites reporting
ww_covid_n_sites.about: Treatment plants in the county with a sample in the last 21 days of the feed.
ww_covid_n_sites.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_covid_wval_level_max.label: COVID-19 wastewater level
ww_covid_wval_level_max.about: Highest CDC wastewater viral activity level among sites in the county for the newest week.
ww_covid_wval_level_max.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_covid_trend_4wk.label: COVID-19 wastewater trend, 4 weeks
ww_covid_trend_4wk.about: Change in virus concentration between the last 2 weeks and the 2 weeks before.
ww_covid_trend_4wk.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_flu_a_n_sites.label: Influenza A sampling sites reporting
ww_flu_a_n_sites.about: Treatment plants in the county with a sample in the last 21 days of the feed.
ww_flu_a_n_sites.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_flu_a_wval_level_max.label: Influenza A wastewater level
ww_flu_a_wval_level_max.about: Highest CDC wastewater viral activity level among sites in the county for the newest week.
ww_flu_a_wval_level_max.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_flu_a_trend_4wk.label: Influenza A wastewater trend, 4 weeks
ww_flu_a_trend_4wk.about: Change in virus concentration between the last 2 weeks and the 2 weeks before.
ww_flu_a_trend_4wk.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_rsv_n_sites.label: RSV sampling sites reporting
ww_rsv_n_sites.about: Treatment plants in the county with a sample in the last 21 days of the feed.
ww_rsv_n_sites.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_rsv_wval_level_max.label: RSV wastewater level
ww_rsv_wval_level_max.about: Highest CDC wastewater viral activity level among sites in the county for the newest week.
ww_rsv_wval_level_max.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_rsv_trend_4wk.label: RSV wastewater trend, 4 weeks
ww_rsv_trend_4wk.about: Change in virus concentration between the last 2 weeks and the 2 weeks before.
ww_rsv_trend_4wk.basis: counted from sites in the county

ww_measles_detected_recent.label: Measles virus in wastewater (last 2 samples)
ww_measles_detected_recent.about: Detected if any current sampling site in the county found measles virus in either of its last 2 samples. Not detected does not mean absent.
ww_measles_detected_recent.basis: counted from sites in the county

measles_cases_ytd.label: Measles cases, this year
measles_cases_ytd.about: Confirmed cases dated January 1 through the newest date in the file.

measles_cases_4wk.label: Measles cases, last 4 weeks
measles_cases_4wk.about: Confirmed cases by reporting date. Where the state has cases not assigned to a county, county values are a floor.

mmr2_kindergarten_ca_low.label: Kindergarten MMR coverage, low bound (California)
mmr2_kindergarten_ca_low.about: Rolled up from school reports. Schools that publish only a floor or a ceiling make a range.

aqi_days_over_100.label: Days with air quality index above 100
aqi_days_over_100.about: Days in the calendar year when the county air quality index (AQI) was above 100, the level EPA calls unhealthy for sensitive groups. Validated history; lags by months.

water_systems_hb_violation_5y.label: Water systems with a health-based violation, 5 years
water_systems_hb_violation_5y.about: Public water systems serving the county with at least one health-based violation whose compliance period began in the last five years. An undercount where county names did not match.
water_systems_hb_violation_5y.basis: counted from sites in the county

superfund_npl_final.label: Superfund sites on the National Priorities List
superfund_npl_final.about: Sites currently on the final National Priorities List.
superfund_npl_final.basis: counted from sites in the county

dc_locations_osm.label: Data center locations in OpenStreetMap
dc_locations_osm.about: Deduplicated OpenStreetMap locations tagged as data centers. One location may be a campus or a single building.
dc_locations_osm.basis: counted from sites in the county
